notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.4
notes.notes:
Heyo!  



This demo update contains mostly small bugfixes, but also a first attempt at proper ultrawide resolution support. 

If you're using an ultrawide monitor to play Dobbel Dungeon and you still encounter issues with UI elements being misaligned after this update, please let us know!



Changelist

Implemented ultrawide resolution support

Fixed an issue where sometimes chasms (e.g. rivers) weren't properly marked as such under the hood

Fixed an issue with duplicate animation triggers.

Fixed an issue where self-targeted actions were still considered for 'apply to enemy' bonus objectives

Fixed an issue where 'Charge'-type actions would not properly end if the unit that used it died mid-action

Fixed a critical issue that could happen when you quit the tutorial mission after having dismissed the first action tutorial



Happy Dobbeling!
- Jim & Michelle

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.3
notes.notes:
Heyo!

This demo update contains mostly small bugfixes and visual quality consistency tweaks.

Changelist

 Fixed windmill not fading out when close to cam on lower quality settings
 Fixed cloud shadows not appearing
 Implemented a graphics setting to toggle Bloom
 Implemented a gameplay setting to toggle Custom Cursor (If you've previously encountered an issue where the cursor did not align with where it was actually at according to the game, please check and let us know if this option addresses that issue).
 AO, AA, DOF and Bloom settings now dynamically adjust themselves when the overall quality level is changed.
 Fixed an issue where 'consuming'-type actions (e.g. Consume Flame) did not work at all
 Fixed an issue where companions could be spawned on invalid tiles
 Fixed an issue where AOE spawnables (e.g. Spike Growth) would spawn on chasms
 Tweaked foliage materials
 Fixed Porc Tent health not responding to difficulty setting
 Adjusted lower quality settings to be more style-consistent with the higher ones.



Happy Dobbeling!
- Jim & Michelle

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.2
notes.notes:
Heyo!

After watching some folks play Dobbel Dungeon live at Animecon (NL), we noticed we still had quite a few issues in the ‘clarity’ department, particularly for the more inexperienced players. 

With this update, we hope to address some of the more ‘major’ issues we noticed to hopefully get newcomers on their way faster, as well as offer some quality-of-life benefits to existing players.

Changelist

 Fixed a critical animation state issue that could happen when ‘Skip dice animations’ was enabled and you tried to dash right after manipulating a die
 Fixed missing boss battle music
 Fixed an issue where remaining overworld nodes became unavailable as soon as the boss node was revealed.
 Implemented an ‘undo movement’ button
 Improved ‘first-turn’ tutorial
 Implemented ‘resistances’ category in unit description card
 Improved unit description card layout
 Implemented (optional) end-of-turn verification
 Valid dice slots are now also highlighted when hovering over a die, instead of only when a die was being dragged
 Dice that are invalid for your currently selected action will now visually indicate this unavailability
 Battle cam now starts at a 45° angle


Oh, one minor side effect of this tutorial upgrade is that existing players might get a repeat of tutorial popups they've already seen. Sorry, but it's for the greater good :P

Happy Dobbeling!
- Jim & Michelle

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Heyo,

We've added new graphics settings for ambient occlusion and depth of field (the most performance intensive post-processing effects in Dobbel Dungeon at this time). So if you've previously had some trouble in the FPS department, playing with these settings might do the trick!

We've also fixed some other stuff, so here's the full list:

Changelog

Implemented graphics settings for ambient occlusion and depth of field
Fixed an issue where hurt and death sounds were played at the same time
Fixed a critical issue related to inspecting an enemy's actions when they are executing them
Improved enemy movement evaluation logic
Fixed an issue where players could spawn in enclosed spaces around buildings
Fixed an issue where 'critical state' music wouldn't trigger for non-hero mission-critical units
Fixed missing font glyphs for eastern languages
Fixed hero passives still showing up in the hero's ghost overview panel
Fixed tutorial music
Fixed shop controller issue where the shop list wouldn't scroll along with your selection properly
Fixed a controller issue where using a teleport action would cause the action card to enter an errored state after completion
Fixed 'exit' button not working on game over screen
Fixed issue where you could continue a failed run
Hotfixed a critical issue that randomly caused the next unit's turn to not start during chicken run. If you still encounter this issue, please let us know.
Balance tweaks


Happy Dobbeling!
- Jimbo

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.4.1.1 Language Fixes
notes.notes:
Heyo,

This patch should fix an issue where a WIP version of the Dutch language was being mixed in with the actually available languages and causing all sorts of trouble.

Also, the demo will now default to English when you first install it, regardless of system language.

Happy Dobbeling!
- Jimbo

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.4.1.1
notes.notes:
Heyo,

This patch should fix an issue related to the way overworld nodes were initialized, which created a critical issue specifically with the shopkeeper's node.

Happy Dobbeling!
- Jimbo

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Heyo,

This patch should fix an issue related to the enemy grid evaluation system that caused enemies to very occasionally just stand still and do nothing.

If you somehow continue to experience this behaviour, please let us know via the in-game feedback tool, as that will also give us a log of in-game events to help track down the root cause!

Happy Dobbeling!
- Jimbo

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.3.7.1
notes.notes:
Heyo,

Looks like I made an oopsie when implementing some recent changes to the cage systems. My bad!

Massive thanks to everyone reporting the issue via the in-game feedback tool!

Changelog:


Fixed issue where the cage wasn't properly removed from the game after being unlocked, which caused the first actor in the initiative order to not be able to do their turn.


Happy Dobbeling!
- Jimbo

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.3.7.0
notes.notes:
Heyo,

Keep that feedback coming so I can keep improving stuff!

Changelog:

Added a new tutorial popup to briefly explain enemy spawners
Reworked the visual language for 'interactables' and added a new tutorial popup to briefly explain how they work
Reworked how cages work: A cage is now classified as an interactable combatant (like a chicken) and can be damaged by friendly fire. Damage sustained to the cage will transfer to the prisoner once released, or if fatal, fail the mission
Fixed an issue where chickens didn't properly notify all subsystems of their new position after being thrown, which caused things like the bear trap not triggering (I still recommend you don't throw chickens into hazards, but I won't judge)
Fixed an issue where the huntress unlock reward was visualized as an epic item in the battle result screen
Equipped items in the hero overview panel can no longer be dragged around and cause issues
Active buff icons in the HUD have been moved into the health bar area, rather than to the right of it, to avoid overlap issues with the action bar


Happy Dobbeling!
- Jimbo

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.3.6.1

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.3.6
notes.notes:
Heyo!

Demo patch 0.3.6 fixes some minor issues here and there.

Massive thanks to everyone who reported these issues via the in-game feedback tool and our discord community! 

Changelog

Fixed a missing sound for Hamlet & Sizzle's Charge attack
Tweaked dice rolling physics slightly to more consistently result in nice 'rolling' motion rather than landing flat immediately
Added a 'community' button in the main menu
Pausing in the overworld now actually pauses the game in the background
Fixed an issue where Flame Step allowed you to teleport into occupied spaces
Improved readability of health bars in quest objectives
Fixed a critical issue when Hamlet & Sizzle were defeated via retaliation
Fixed an issue where Flame Step caused defeated enemies to be registered twice for 'defeat x enemies with 1 action' objective
Fixed a minor order of execution issue regarding automatically failing quest objectives at the end of a battle if the objective was actually completed during the last action of the battle.
Fixed an issue where cutscenes & tutorials didn't properly update game time speed when triggered / ended.


Happy Dobbeling!
- Jimbo
